environment.description: Same Spring Boot service deployed on EKS 1.27 with CloudHSM. ElastiCache Redis 7.x with RBAC enabled (ACL user with read-only GET permission on 'signatureVerification::*' keyspace pattern for the application connection, write operations restricted to a separate internal-only service account authenticated via IAM-based Redis AUTH token rotation). Additionally, a Cilium L7 network policy enforces that only the signing-service pod identity (SPIFFE ID spiffe://cluster.local/ns/crypto/sa/signer-sa) can issue SET/DEL commands to the Redis cache prefix. The application pod's Cilium identity only permits GET operations at the L7 Redis protocol parser level. Pod-to-pod traffic within the namespace is further constrained by a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy that blocks ingress to Redis from any pod not labeled 'role=cache-writer'.

config.cache: ElastiCache Redis 7.0 with RBAC, ACL user 'app-reader' has '+get ~signatureVerification::*' only
config.network_policy: Cilium L7 policy with Redis protocol awareness, app pod identity restricted to GET commands
config.redis_auth: IAM-authenticated AUTH token, rotated every 12h via Secrets Manager
config.k8s_netpol: NetworkPolicy restricts Redis 6379 ingress to pods with label role=cache-writer
config.pod_identity: SPIFFE-based mTLS between pods, write identity only granted to signer-sa
